_comment: One entry per event. id is stable; event pages reference it in event placeholders (see CLAUDE.md, Events data). Dates are Korea time; use YYYY-MM-DD for all-day events and full ISO with +09:00 for timed ones. page is a key from tooling/build-mocks.mjs PAGES; anchor is optional. status: open when registration is open. approximate + allDay shows only the month.

events.title: All Star basketball tournament
events.summary: Third annual mental-health awareness tournament with the Peninsula Basketball League and the Humphreys Hoop Club. Free.

events.title: Achievement Week essay contest: entries due
events.summary: College-bound seniors at Daegu, Osan and Humphreys high schools. 700 to 750 words. Awards of $500, $300 and $200.

events.title: Youth Leadership Conference
events.summary: Grades 9 to 12. Free, limited to the first 60 students. With the RoK Alumnae Chapter of Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Inc.

events.title: Achievement Week 2026
events.summary: Recognition of community contributions, the essay contest awards and the banquet.

events.title: New Year's Eve Party at Dragon Hill Lodge
events.summary: Children's party, the adults' party with the midnight balloon drop, and a midnight breakfast buffet. Runs every year; the next edition will be announced here.

events.title: Scholarship applications open
events.summary: Future Leaders Scholarship ($2,500, three students) and the Bro. Carl Reed Scholarship ($3,000, one student, HBCU-bound).

events.title: 50th Anniversary weekend
events.summary: Five decades of Lambda Xi on the Peninsula. Programme and venue to follow; donations open now.
